core_meaning.short_meaning: A month of the Persian calendar
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Inayah (عناية) is the name of a month in the traditional Persian calendar, used as a given name.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Name of a month in the Persian calendar
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Inayah corresponds to the Arabic form عناية (Arabic root ع ن ي (ʿ-n-y); عِنَايَة (ʿInāya)). Its core sense is care, providence, solicitude. Inayah is Arabic عِنَايَة (ʿInāya) 'care, providence, solicitude', from the root ع ن ي (ʿ-n-y). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source glossed the name as "Name of the month of Sha'ban", which is unsupported; the lexical sense is 'care, providence'. Same name as inaya and inayat.

etymology.morphology: Built on the root ع ن ي.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ع ن ي (ʿ-n-y)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عناية is an established Arabic lexical item, and Inayah is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: This is a calendar-month name; it does not carry a devotional or Quranic meaning, and any gloss that presents it as an Arabic religious term is unsupported.

urdu.name: عنایہ
urdu.long_meaning: Inayah (عنایہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم عنانایت، دیکھ بھال، پروا ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: عنایه
persian.long_meaning: Inayah (عنایه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عناایت، مراقبت، پروا است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: इनाया
hindi.long_meaning: Inayah (इनाया) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ देखभाल, कृपा, परवाह है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: عنایه
pashto.long_meaning: Inayah (عنایه) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې پاملرنه، عنایت، پروا ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: عناية
arabic.long_meaning: Inayah (عناية) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي العناية، الرعاية، الاهتمام. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Inayah is a month-name turned given name: it borrows a word from the Arabic calendar and uses it to mark a child with the qualities the month evokes.

faq.a: Inayah (عناية) is the name of a month in the traditional Persian calendar.

faq.q: What is the origin of Inayah?
faq.a: Inayah originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming communities.
Yes, the recorded form عناية is Arabic.

faq.q: What is the root of Inayah?
faq.a: It is built on the root ع ن ي (ʿ-n-y).
Inayah is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Inayah is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Inayah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written عنایہ and carries the sense “عنانایت، دیکھ بھال، پروا”.

faq.q: Is Inayah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Inayah as a girl's name; actual use can vary by community.
